title: 第813章 温和到要命的笑容
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

神龙崩殂，神韵流散，福泽四溢。

继承其真源血脉，更是有天生威能。

只是神龙传承而下的真源血脉是会随着传承不断流逝，直至血脉彻底消散，原因也研究了许久，也尝试过许多法子，但就是捉摸不透，不可挽回。

所以数千年前曾经叱咤风云的继承真源血脉那些神兽尽数销声匿迹。

就连自身腾蛇，也全仗着云梦泽的神龙福泽才还能维系血脉，还才算留下来。

可这终究不是办法，如今的云泽自身还能勉强说得上是个腾蛇，可如果再传，还是不是个腾蛇那就真的是只有天知道了。

或许真源血脉实在强的离谱本就不属于人间，所以不能补充只会消散。

对于楚星尘所提出的提议，云泽自然是心动的，首先云离远比它更纯粹的真源血脉是肯定的，而且能有神海传承，云离保不准是什么千年老物藏起来的上古东西。

如果真有什么法门，要是能继续维系自身腾蛇完整，那自然是极好的。

哪怕收益大部分都是云离，但在云泽的视角之中也是可以接受的。

毕竟现在要是不分，云泽将来想分恐怕也分不了。

有口热汤喝总比没有的强，腾蛇血脉能多传一代那也好，要是法门能长期维持，那更是赚翻了。

维系腾蛇血脉，对于云梦来说也是首要任务。

云梦心中自然倾向于先应下看看情况如何，但思虑片刻，它压下了心中所有悸动和渴望。

“既然前辈愿意商议，那在下自然明白前辈的诚意。”云泽再次行礼，语气谦卑道，“只不过此事事关重大，还请容我思虑片刻。”

云梦泽不管怎讲，也不管是否承认，如今也是寄下在云梦阁。

纵然如今能仗着楚星尘的威名自行答应，但将来恐怕也是要为此付出代价。

毕竟云梦阁可也不是吃素的。

不管如今诱惑有多大，但为了云梦泽将来存续，现在无论如何也不能先行答应。

至少在找到合适的理由，或者得到云梦阁的认可之后。

楚星尘闻言笑了笑，神色也未有恼怒，只是语气平静道：

“既然是商议，那自然是要道友有时间慢慢想，要是道友不允，也在情理之中。”

云梦听见这话有些松了口气，不管是不是场面话，但至少现在说的好听，它脸上也露出笑意：

“多谢前辈体谅……”

云梦话未说完，门口便有小妖侍女急匆匆的快步走来，接着向云梦匍匐跪地。

“我不是说今日接待贵客，任何事情都要往后吗？”云梦眉头微皱，语气还算温和开口道，“什么事都往后推，下去吧。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The divine dragon dies, the charm is dispersed, and blessings overflow.

Inheriting his true origin bloodline, he has innate power.

It's just that the true bloodline inherited from Shenlong will continue to pass away with the inheritance until the bloodline completely dissipates. The reason has been studied for a long time and many methods have been tried, but it is elusive and irreversible.

Therefore, all the mythical beasts that inherited the True Origin bloodline that were once all-powerful thousands of years ago disappeared.

Even the Soaring Snake himself only relied on Yun Mengze's Divine Dragon Fortune to maintain his bloodline and survive.

But this is not a solution after all. Now Yunze himself can barely be said to be a Soaring Snake, but if it is passed down again, only God knows whether he is still a Soaring Snake.

Perhaps the True Source bloodline is so ridiculously strong that it does not belong to the human world, so it will only dissipate if it cannot be replenished.

Yunze was naturally moved by Chu Xingchen's proposal. First of all, it was certain that Yunli had a purer True Origin bloodline than him, and it could be inherited by the Divine Sea. Yunli could not guarantee that it was an ancient thing hidden away by a thousand-year-old thing.

If there really is a way to keep the Soaring Snake intact, that would be great.

Even if most of the income goes to Yunli, it is still acceptable from Yunze's perspective.

After all, if they don't separate now, Yunze probably won't be able to separate them if he wants to in the future.

Having hot soup to drink is better than nothing. It would be great if the Teng She bloodline can be passed down to one more generation. If the method can be maintained for a long time, it will be even more profitable.

Maintaining the bloodline of Soaring Snake is also a top priority for Yunmeng.

Yunmeng's heart was naturally inclined to go down and see what the situation was like, but after thinking for a moment, she suppressed all the throbbing and longing in her heart.

"Since senior is willing to discuss, I naturally understand senior's sincerity." Yunze saluted again and said in a humble tone, "But this matter is of great importance, please allow me to think about it for a moment."

No matter what Yun Mengze said, no matter whether he admitted it or not, he still sent it to Yunmeng Pavilion.

Even if he can rely on Chu Xingchen's reputation to agree now, he may have to pay a price for it in the future.

After all, Yunmeng Pavilion is not a vegetarian.

No matter how big the temptation is now, for the sake of Yun Mengze's future survival, he can't agree to it now.

At least after finding a suitable reason or getting approval from Yunmeng Pavilion.

Chu Xingchen smiled when he heard this. He didn't look angry, but said calmly:

"Since it is a discussion, it is natural that the Taoist friends should have time to think about it slowly. If the Taoist friends do not agree, it is reasonable."

Yunmeng was a little relieved when he heard this. Regardless of whether it was a scene or not, at least it sounded nice now, and a smile appeared on its face:

"Thank you for your understanding, senior..."

Before Yunmeng finished speaking, a little demon maid hurriedly walked towards the door, then knelt down towards Yunmeng.

"Didn't I say that when we receive distinguished guests today, we should postpone everything until later?" Yun Meng frowned slightly and said in a gentle tone, "Put off everything until later. Go on."
